data.summary: Sprachforum Beispiellahn e.V. invites Kwame Asante to the German B1 evening course starting 12 January 2027 and asks him to register for a placement test slot by 10 December 2026.
data.explanation: The language school wants you to book a placement test slot before you can be enrolled in the January German B1 course. Use the link in their e-mail to pick a slot before the deadline shown, since places are limited to sixteen per course and could fill up. If you miss the deadline, you risk losing your spot in the course. No payment or contract terms are mentioned yet in this letter.
